IC1: - Men [OR] or women of any race or ethnicity aged 18 or older
IC2: - [NOT] No symptoms of ALS [OR] or fronto-temporal dementia at enrollment
IC3: - Have a first degree relative who had an ALS- spectrum diagnosis [AND] with a confirmed ALS-spectrum gene mutation; [OR] or already have had genetic testing [AND] and have tested positive for an ALS-spectrum gene mutation.
IC4: - Willing to undergo genetic testing with option of whether or not to learn results
IC5: - Willing to travel to Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC) every 6-24 months for study procedures
IC6: - Capable of providing informed consent and following study procedures, or has a legally authorized representative who is able to consent for the subject.
